itemList.description:
Design, fabrication, supply, erection, installation and maintenance on hire basis of a beautification and artificial flower pasting on the Teddybear structure and water overflowing buckets ( lilium,roses and mixed flowers)at the entrance of park inside Karnataka Exhibition Authority for Dasara Exhibition-2026 
Technical Specification
The contractor shall provide complete MS/GI structural framework, including base frame, supports, bracing etc., 
Complete theme designing and 3D concept development shall be carried out by the contractor and submitted for Client approval before fabrication. 
The contractor shall provide all materials, skilled/unskilled manpower, transportation, loading/unloading, scaffolding, lifting equipment, tools, PPE and installation equipment required for complete execution.
Hire & Maintenance
The replica shall be provided on hire for the period specified in the Work Order, including complete erection and dismantling/removal after the hire period. The contractor shall provide 3 months comprehensive maintenance, including regular inspection, cleaning other floral materials as required to maintain the approved appearance complete as per instructed by the Engineer in- Charges
